name: Aoze 1.3.0
bodyHtml:
Aoze 1.3.0: A guided tour of Aoze, shown once.

New

  • Tutorial: a short guided tour of every section (home, images & GIFs, clips, convert, history, settings, help). The element being explained is highlighted with an arrow and a short note; click it to go on. Nothing opens or changes during the tour.
  • Each chapter is announced by the welcome voice. It follows the startup voice setting.
  • Skip it anytime (Esc). Once finished or skipped, it never comes back on its own; Help → Replay the tutorial shows it again.

Download Aoze_1.3.0_x64-setup.exe, run it, done (FFmpeg and every engine are included).
Aoze 1.1.0 and later update themselves: they offer the new version when it is out.
The installer is per-user (no admin rights). It is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen
may show "Windows protected your PC": choose "More info", then "Run anyway".

SHA-256 of Aoze_1.3.0_x64-setup.exe: 9b5b8447b54d6138e43c8f70339c5a1d2ac823d2da1ab4dceb8fa5af1be17277
(all files: SHA256SUMS.txt). Third-party licences: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and
THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt.

Made for aoxy, by zero.
